theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U (k + 1)) (μ μ' : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P (k + 1)) (ξ' : Euclid P → MultiVector P k) (g : Euclid P → ℝ) (η : TestFormOn U k), (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) (k + 1), |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U (k + 1), T ω = ∫ x, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (k + 1)) x) ∂μ) → (∀ θ : TestFormOn U k, T.boundary θ = ∫ x, ξ' x ((θ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂μ') → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g → ENNReal.ofReal |∫ x, g x * ξ x (exteriorDerivative (η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂μ - ∫ x, g x * ξ' x ((η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂μ'| ≤ ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (‖fderiv ℝ g x‖ * covectorEuclideanNorm ((η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x)) ∂μ
